__doc__: Per-monster overrides for the breath-weapon deriver (tools/derive_breath_weapons.py). Each key is a monster name from DND2024_MonsterStats.json. An entry's 'action' selects how its recharge/breath Action-Notes clause is handled: 'catalog' forces a specific generic Breath<...> spell (overriding the auto-tiered pick, e.g. to fix a mis-parsed size); 'inline' mints a dedicated catalog spell from a full spell dict (for size/damage/element outliers that don't fit the Low/Medium/High/Enormous grid); 'skip' defers the action (condition-only or mechanically-special breaths handled in a later pass). Keys starting with __ are ignored.
__tiers__: Auto-tiered breaths use d6 dice (a Burning Hands reskin): Low=6d6, Medium=11d6, High=17d6, Enormous=24d6. Tier sizes — Cone: 15/30/60/90 ft; Line: 30x5 / 60x5 / 90x5 / 120x10; Sphere/Emanation/Cube: 15/20/30/60 ft radius. Save by element — Dex: fire/lightning/acid/force/radiant; Con: cold/poison/necrotic/thunder; Int: psychic.

Behir.comment: Action Notes phrase 'within 90ft wide and 5ft line' parses to a swapped 90-wide/5-long line; it is really a 90ft x 5ft lightning line (~66 dmg = High).

Tarrasque.comment: 150ft thunder cone, bigger than the Enormous (90ft) tier. Deafened+Frightened riders deferred to the condition pass.
Tarrasque.name: BreathThunderConeColossal

Colossus.comment: 300ft x 10ft radiant line, far longer than the Enormous (120ft) line tier.
Colossus.name: BreathRadiantLineColossal

Sphinx of Lore.comment: 300ft psychic emanation (each enemy within 300ft); Incapacitated rider deferred.
Sphinx of Lore.name: BreathPsychicEmanationColossal

Death Knight.comment: Hellfire: 20ft sphere, mixed Fire+Necrotic (~70 dmg) — multi-element, not a single-type tier.
Death Knight.name: BreathFireNecroticSphereHigh

Dire Worg.comment: Dreadful Howl: '30ft on fail 36 psychic and frightened' has a bare '30ft' the auto-parser can't shape; a 30ft psychic emanation falls in the High size-tier. Frightened rider deferred to the condition pass.

Air Elemental.comment: Whirlwind: single-target push+prone, not an AoE breath.

Water Elemental.comment: Whelm: enter-space grapple/restrain/suffocate + ongoing damage — mechanically special.

Brazen Gorgon.comment: Smelting Charge: a movement-charge attack, not a save AoE.

Sea Hag.comment: Death Glare: HP-threshold instakill + fear — special.

Ghost.comment: Possession: long-duration incapacitate with bespoke end condition.

Gnoll Pack Lord.comment: Incite Rampage: grants an ally a bonus-action attack — action economy, not a breath.

Elemental Cataclysm.comment: Cataclysmic Event: four selectable sub-effects — needs bespoke modelling.

Salamander Inferno Master.comment: Inferno Blast: ongoing per-turn fire + exhaustion — special.

Graveyard Revenant.comment: Unnamed recharge paralyze (no damage) — condition pass.

Giant Spider.comment: Unnamed Web restrain (no damage) — condition pass.

Swarm of Ravens.comment: Unnamed deafen rider (no damage) — condition pass.
